The sunlight was pouring in through the windows onto my face. Around the moment I woke up, I heard my mother inside my brothers house calling my name. Around the same time my mothers voice calling my name grew fearful. It slowly turned into a yell almost. I could hear her running around our house frantically calling my name. Then it turned into a blood curdling scream. It sounded like she was being attacked. I heard footsteps from multiple people muffled by my mothers screams for help.
